changelog:
v3.5.11 — libVLC ProGuard Fix + HEVC Main 10 Threshold Fix

• ROOT CAUSE FIX: Added missing ProGuard keep rule for libVLC classes (-keep class org.videolan.** { *; }). R8 was stripping JNI-accessed classes (IMedia$Slave etc.) causing UnsatisfiedLinkError on every libVLC init. This was the actual root cause behind ALL 'VLC crash on MTK' reports since v3.5.6 — the crashes were ProGuard stripping, not HEVC decoder failures.
• Fixed: HEVC Main 10 gate now uses total device RAM (>= 1.2GB) instead of device tier. AFTKRT and AFTMM can play HDR content again via libVLC. Only AFTSS (900MB) is blocked.
• libVLC fallback now works correctly on all devices with sufficient RAM.
